treatment: Use copper-based fungicides. Ensure good air circulation.
Apply sulfur-based spray or neem oil. Reduce humidity.
Remove infected leaves. Apply fungicide containing tebuconazole.
Crop rotation and clean seeds. Apply chlorothalonil.
Avoid wet foliage. Apply metalaxyl or mancozeb.
Improve soil drainage. Drench soil with carbendazim.
Prune infected branches. Spray copper oxychloride.
Control aphids/vectors. Remove and burn infected plants.
